library(revlitquery)  # 1. Write and parse a 6-article demo BibTeX file demo_bib <- file.path(tempdir(), "demo_seeds.bib") revlitquery:::.write_demo_bibtex(demo_bib) #> [1] "/tmp/RtmpGTZnN1/demo_seeds.bib"  seeds_df <- parse_bibtex(demo_bib) seeds_df[, c("citekey", "year", "pmid", "title")] #> # A tibble: 6 × 4 #>   citekey                   year  pmid     title                                 #>   <chr>                     <chr> <chr>    <chr>                                 #> 1 li2008estimates           2008  18439345 Estimates of the case fatality rate … #> 2 wang2012serological       2012  22362880 Serological evidence of human infect… #> 3 fiebig2011epidemiological 2011  21679679 Epidemiological and clinical charact… #> 4 kandun2008factors         2008  18959499 Factors associated with case fatalit… #> 5 lai2016global             2016  27211899 Global epidemiology of avian influen… #> 6 cowling2013comparative    2013  23803488 Comparative epidemiology of human in… # 2. Prepare local seed text fields (offline; use enrich_seeds() for live PubMed enrichment) seeds_local <- seeds_df seeds_local$in_pubmed <- nzchar(seeds_local$pmid) seeds_local$full_title <- seeds_local$title seeds_local$full_abstract <- seeds_local$abstract seeds_local$full_text <- tolower(paste(seeds_local$title, seeds_local$abstract))  # 3. Extract candidate n-grams and prefix wildcards (offline mode: probe_pubmed = FALSE) terms_df <- extract_candidate_terms(   seeds_df     = seeds_local,   config       = list(),   probe_pubmed = FALSE ) head(terms_df[, c("term", "n_words", "df_tiab", "df_title", "lift", "term_score")], 10) #> # A tibble: 10 × 6 #>    term               n_words df_tiab df_title  lift term_score #>    <chr>                <int>   <int>    <int> <dbl>      <dbl> #>  1 avian influenza          2       5        5 1267.       4.01 #>  2 human h5n1               2       5        2 1267.       3.90 #>  3 h5n1                     1       6        6  190.       3.54 #>  4 case fatality            2       5        2 1267.       3.39 #>  5 human                    1       6        5  190.       2.94 #>  6 influenza                1       6        5  190.       2.94 #>  7 case fatality rate       3       3        1 9495.       2.55 #>  8 fatality                 1       6        2  190.       2.54 #>  9 avian                    1       5        5  158.       2.47 #> 10 case                     1       5        3  158.       2.22 # 4. Discover unsupervised orthogonal concept blocks (Hybrid Contrastive Graph + Set-Cover) blocks <- build_concept_blocks(   terms_df = terms_df,   seeds_df = seeds_local,   config   = list(max_blocks = 3, max_terms_per_block = 4) ) str(blocks) #> List of 3 #>  $ :List of 2 #>   ..$ name : chr "primary_topic" #>   ..$ terms: chr [1:2] "avian influenza" "influenza" #>  $ :List of 2 #>   ..$ name : chr "concept_human_h5n1" #>   ..$ terms: chr [1:2] "human h5n1" "confirmed human" #>   ..- attr(*, "cluster_id")= chr "concept_human_h5n1" #>  $ :List of 2 #>   ..$ name : chr "concept_case_fatality" #>   ..$ terms: chr [1:2] "case fatality" "fatality risk" #>   ..- attr(*, "narrow_term")= chr "case fatality rate" #>   ..- attr(*, "cluster_id")= chr "concept_case_fatality" #>  - attr(*, "block1_coupled")= chr [1:3] "avian influenza" "influenza" "avian" #>  - attr(*, "joint_hits")= Named num(0)  #>   ..- attr(*, "names")= chr(0)  #>  - attr(*, "term_clusters")= Named chr [1:50] "primary_topic" "concept_human_h5n1" "concept_human_h5n1" "concept_case_fatality" ... #>   ..- attr(*, "names")= chr [1:50] "avian influenza" "human h5n1" "h5n1" "case fatality" ... #>  - attr(*, "domain_qualifier")= chr(0) # 5. Translate a structured query specification into PubMed & Google Scholar syntax q <- make_query(   blocks = list(     list(name = "primary_topic", terms = c("h5n1", "h5"), field = "tiab"),     list(name = "domain_context", terms = "influenza", field = "tiab"),     list(name = "concept_fatal", terms = c("fatal*", "case fatality"), field = "tiab")   ),   exclude_terms = c("h7n9", "h1n1*", "vaccin*") )  cat("PubMed query:
", to_pubmed_query(q), "

title: How revlitquery Works: The Workflow Step by Step
text: Instead predefined concept list, build_concept_blocks() discovers structure topic data: best high-lift anchor becomes primary topic block. discover_term_clusters() builds graph candidate terms. Edges combine local-context MeSH/keyword similarity (small latent semantic analysis), coverage complementarity (two terms cover different seeds likely interchangeable synonyms), lexical similarity. Louvain community detection groups terms concepts. Within community greedy set-cover grows block; blocks combined . can always override discovery custom_blocks configuration.
code: blocks <- build_concept_blocks(   terms, seeds,   max_blocks = 3L,   probe_selectivity = TRUE,   eval_joint_fn = function(t1, t2) 2500L   # stand-in for a PubMed joint count ) for (b in blocks) cat(sprintf("%-22s %s\n", b$name, paste(b$terms, collapse = " | "))) #> primary_topic          fragmented | pollinator #> concept_decline        decline #> concept_agricultural   agricultural | loss | abundance | richness

title: How revlitquery Works: The Workflow Step by Step
text: generate_initial_candidates() combines block specificity tiers fields (title vs. title/abstract) diverse candidates, discarding exceed 256 characters translated. query canonical object to_pubmed_query() to_google_scholar_query() translate syntax (Google Scholar truncation operator, wildcards expanded dominant corpus word morphological stem). Without network access, estimate_local_query() scores query seed texts, optimizer uses pre-rank candidates spending PubMed calls.

Verified hit reductions come live PubMed counts.

title: How revlitquery Works: The Workflow Step by Step
text: optimize_queries() runs two-stage search fixed evaluation budget (max_evals). Stage 1 evaluates initial candidates live. Stage 2a adds exclusion-refined variants. Stage 2b greedily generates neighbours current Pareto queries: prune term, switch field, swap narrower variant, add rescue term concept cluster seeds still missed, add qualifier block, extend exclusions. round re-evaluates promising neighbours stops frontier stops improving.

Google Scholar: exact semantic translation adhering Google Scholar syntax (intitle:, implicit , uppercase , -exclude, <= 256 characters) corpus-derived wildcard stem completion clickable verification links. Unsupervised Inclusion & Exclusion Concept Discovery: domain-agnostic distributional context (SVD/LSA + MeSH/Keyword projection + seed complementarity) Louvain graph clustering orthogonal set-cover inclusion /blocks, paired Normalized Pointwise Mutual Information (NPMI) co-occurrence topic clustering non-seed PubMed results zero-loss / - exclusion blocks across scientific discipline.

title: revlitquery 0.1.0
text: Initial release revlitquery: Reverse Literature Review Search Query Optimizer PubMed Google Scholar. Added BibTeX parser (parse_bibtex()) PubMed seed metadata enrichment (enrich_seeds()) year-assisted title matching, Author Keyword indexing, per-PMID disk caching. Added candidate term extraction (extract_candidate_terms()), unsupervised morphological prefix wildcard synthesis (*), domain-agnostic Hybrid Contrastive Graph + Orthogonal Set-Cover concept block discovery (discover_term_clusters(), build_concept_blocks()). Added canonical boolean query representation (make_query()) translators PubMed (to_pubmed_query()) Google Scholar (<= 256 characters; to_google_scholar_query(), pubmed_to_google_scholar_approx()). Added two-stage sensitivity-specificity Pareto frontier optimizer (optimize_queries(), optimize_search_queries()) timeline-stratified, unsupervised NPMI co-occurrence noise topic clustering (cluster_exclusion_terms(), discover_exclusion_hints()). Added interactive Shiny dashboard (revlitquery_app(), run_revlitquery_app()) two package vignettes (shiny-interface cli--r-workflow).
